findings.rationale: The tf_cloudtrail_disabled fixture was scoped and materialized by run_range, containing an aws_cloudtrail.main resource where logging is disabled, creating a blind spot for API audit events.

The tf_s3_no_access_logging fixture was scoped and materialized by run_range, containing an aws_s3_bucket.audit_logs resource with no corresponding aws_s3_bucket_logging resource, so object-level access to this bucket is unlogged.
